name: Theme Builder
description: Live theme editor for the Jellyfin web client: colours, cards, details pages, player, presets and more.
overview: Adds a Theme Editor to the user menu with a live preview. The theme applies to every web client and is copied into Custom CSS for TV apps.

versions.changelog: Theme Editor reorganised: tabs, an Essentials view, dependent options indented and folded, one Hide list per page, search with everyday words. Click the page to find the options that style it. Device badges and greyed-out options that say why. TV preview shows real remote-focus states. TV focus colours chosen by contrast; clicked buttons no longer stay accent. Injection status on the plugin page, self-repair every few minutes and an Activity warning. Hidden SyncPlay icon returns while in a group.
